# PackMaster matcher benchmark

Synthetic registry and cases only (no customer data). Read-only: records current matcher behavior.
- Groups: `matched` = matcher status matched; `review` = matcher status unmatched (goes to the Review screen); `ambiguous` = matcher status ambiguous.
- Verdict: `OK` = actual group equals expected group; `WRONG` = current behavior differs from the intended result (kept on purpose as the baseline).
- WRONG kinds: `false match` = accepted a row that should not be accepted; `missed` = expected matched but not matched; `other` = review/ambiguous mix-up.

Cases: 21 | OK: 10 | WRONG: 11 (false match 7, missed 4, other 0) | SETUP ERROR: 0
Coverage: 6/6 required tags present

## Wrong answers (11)

- TR-01 (Shopee: title cut with no ellipsis, variant appended): expected matched, actual review (catalog_text_not_found). Title prefix plus whole-word variant should reach the 3ห่อ row.
- TR-03 (Shopee: same truncation, but variant ดำ is not in registry): expected review, actual matched (registry_catalog_exact_verified (ellipsis_catalog_match)). Short variant ดำ is dropped by the ellipsis fallback, so the ขาว row is wrongly accepted.
- SV-01 (TikTok: ellipsis title, short variant 3ห่อ, two rows share the title): expected matched, actual ambiguous (duplicate_ellipsis_catalog_match). Variant 3ห่อ is under 6 characters, so it is dropped and both rows tie.
- SV-02 (Shopee: ellipsis title, short variant 3ห่อ, two rows share the title): expected matched, actual ambiguous (duplicate_ellipsis_catalog_match). Same tie as SV-01 on the Shopee path.
- SV-03 (Shopee: ellipsis title, short variant Blue, two variants share the title): expected matched, actual ambiguous (duplicate_ellipsis_catalog_match). Blue is under 6 characters and is dropped, so Blue and Red tie.
- NS-01 (TikTok: SKU not in registry, title matches row ม่วง10, PDF says 2 ห่อ): expected review, actual matched (registry_catalog_exact_verified (exact_title_fallback)). A new SKU with a title-only match and a conflicting variant must not be treated as verified.
- NS-03 (TikTok: SKU not in registry, title matches a row assigned by another SKU): expected review, actual matched (registry_catalog_exact_verified (exact_title_fallback)). The title fallback is re-keyed to the row's registered SKU (canonicalEvidence), so the unknown SKU inherits the verified name instead of going to Review.
- NS-04 (TikTok: SKU not in registry, title matches row ชมพู, PDF says ม่วง (variant colour conflict)): expected review, actual matched (registry_catalog_exact_verified (exact_title_fallback)). A title-only match must not ignore a conflicting colour variant.
- PS-01 (Shopee: แพ็ค 3 text, only แพ็ค 30 is registered): expected review, actual matched (registry_catalog_exact_verified (ellipsis_catalog_match)). Prefix match of แพ็ค 3 onto แพ็ค 30 must not be accepted.
- PK-01 (Shopee: 1.5 ห่อ text, only 15 ห่อ is registered): expected review, actual matched (registry_catalog_exact_verified (skeleton_catalog_match)). The decimal point is dropped by the skeleton fallback, so 1.5 becomes 15.
- PK-03 (Shopee: 5+5 ชิ้น text, only 55 ชิ้น is registered): expected review, actual matched (registry_catalog_exact_verified (skeleton_catalog_match)). The plus sign is dropped by the skeleton fallback, so 5+5 becomes 55.
